new_finding_acceptance_spans_are_not_per.consequence: 63% of gates do not have their own acceptance criterion. The entire U50 performance ladder (34->40->50->60->70->80->90) shares ONE span, so the six rungs have identical stated criteria and cannot be distinguished from each other. All four FPGA gates share span 9000-9061, which is APPENDIX K, a Rust SCHEMA DUMP declaring TransportGenome/FPGAGenome/HBMGenome/HardwareProfile -- a data model, not a proof obligation. FPGA_HWIR's acceptance has never been run because there is nothing there to run: the roadmap frontier's 'acceptance criterion has never been run' is a misdiagnosis.

what_was_broken.root_cause: The canonical roadmap ~/Downloads/H-ROADMAP.md is external by user placement and was moved to the Trash on 2026-08-29. A byte-identical copy had already been committed to docs/roadmap-lineage/ on 2026-09-02 with its sha256 in PRESERVATION.md, and none of the twelve modules hardcoding the ~/Downloads path was repointed at it.
what_was_broken.second_defect_found_by_accident: civilization/build_state.py and tools/roadmap/recompile.py both write civilization/ROADMAP_STATE.json with incompatible schemas, and build_state parses no arguments, so any invocation overwrote whichever ledger was on disk. It destroyed the live 83-gate v3 ledger during this repair; recovered from HEAD and now guarded.
